quest.title: To Mondstadt
quest.description: The astrologist Mona, who you met by chance outside Liyue Harbor, has promised that if you go with her to Mondstadt to fulfill her appointment, she will help you read the truth behind the gods and your sibling. Leaving Liyue Harbor, you head towards Mondstadt.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x625, Mora x38100, Hero's Wit x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x8

talks.objective: Go to Wangshu Inn en route to Mondstadt

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Since it's Mona's treat, we can order whatever we want, right?

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Of course. I am a most generous master, after all. But only if you can finish it all. Wasting food simply will not do.

talks.objective: Sit next to the table and accept Mona's invitation
Talk to Mona and enjoy a good meal

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll order them all.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: A—All of them? We only have three... No, two and a half people? Isn't that too much food?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's not how you count it! Besides, Paimon hasn't even ordered yet!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Squirrel Fish, Jueyun Chili Chicken, and Jewelry Soup, please!

dialogues.speaker: Yuhua
dialogues.text: Sure. And is there anything else that you would like to order, ma'am?

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: I—I'd just like to ask, how much do the current dishes cost in total?

dialogues.speaker: Yuhua
dialogues.text: Um, around twenty thousand Mora.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Then... Uh, I—I'll just have some vegetarian noodles, please.

dialogues.speaker: Yuhua
dialogues.text: Alright. A bowl of vegetarian noodles, was it? Please wait a moment, we will serve you shortly.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's been thinking about something since we started eating...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why did she only order one dish?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is it... because she actually doesn't have money?

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: I heard that! I said I was treating. How could I be rattled by something as mundane as Mora!?

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: An astrologist's mind is set on studying the stars. Being so easily disturbed by such banal matters would hamper my judgment.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Especially the act of overly gratifying oneself using Mora. It is both vulgar...
*stomach grumble*

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: ...and dangerous.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So not eating the dishes we ordered is also part of an astrologist's pride? Paimon doesn't get it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But it feels kinda bad that only we got to feast...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let me whip something up for you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, yes! We can do that! Just give us a minute!

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: There's no need to spend all that effort on me, I'm not in dire need of food...

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: I am a little hungry... but it's not a big deal.

talks.objective: Look for the innkeeper and ask to borrow the kitchen to make Mona a dish

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: Hello, how may I help you?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We'd like to borrow the kitchen here.

choices.text: A friend of mine would like to eat a special dish.

response.speaker: Huai'an
response.text: Ah, I see. In that case, sure. As long as you've prepared your own ingredients, feel free to use the kitchen.

response.speaker: Huai'an
response.text: If I may... You must be well-versed in the art of cooking, yes?

choices.text: Of course. If I make it, it's delicious!

response.speaker: Huai'an
response.text: Haha, talented indeed. Actually, I have a small suggestion to make...

response.speaker: Huai'an
response.text: From your clothes, you're most likely not from around these parts. But since you've come to Liyue, would you like to try making Liyue-style cuisine?

response.speaker: Huai'an
response.text: I have a recipe for Golden Crab with me. It's a Yue cuisine classic.

response.speaker: Huai'an
response.text: It's crab meat that's been rolled in flour, deep-fried, and then pan-fried together with ginger and garlic. When you finally plate it up, the crab seems to be lying on gold.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Golden... Crab!

choices.text: That sounds a little complicated.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Golden Crab, {NICKNAME}! Golden Crab!

choices.text: I got it, I got it. Golden Crab.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Heh-heh. Then let's get to it!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: With your skills in the kitchen, this'll be a cinch!

choices.text: ...I guess I'm learning it for your sake, too.
Learning a whole new dish for Mona's sake is a bit...
Not really...

response.speaker: Huai'an
response.text: Haha, how humble of you. Actually, I have a little suggestion...

choices.text: My friend would like to eat something made by me.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Phew. That was tiring, but we're finally in Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: The quest to plumb the wondrous depths of knowledge is indeed arduous...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's not tired.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Ugh, that's because you float.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, it doesn't look like an astrologist is all that amazing either.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: That's because you have too many unrealistic fantasies about astrology.

dialogues.speaker: Tyler
dialogues.text: Are you also resting your feet here?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Who are you?

dialogues.speaker: Tyler
dialogues.text: Oh, my brothers and I are all merchants. We just finished doing business in Liyue, and we're preparing to head back to Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Tyler
dialogues.text: You look rather tired. The cart we hired will be coming in a while — what say you to coming along for the ride?

choices.text: Well, I am a little tired...

response.speaker: Tyler
response.text: Haha, let's go, then. We can make conversation along the way, the more the merrier.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: There's no need. Now shoo. Get out of our way.

response.speaker: Tyler
response.text: Eh? Miss... Is there something wrong?

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Cease your pretensions, bandit.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Picking up people on the road who appear vulnerable, robbing them blind once they've gotten on the cart, and then taking them to some archon-forsaken place — is that your deal?

response.speaker: Tyler
response.text: Wh—What are you saying? We came over here to make conversation, and this is how we're rewarded? With insults?

response.speaker: Tyler
response.text: If you don't want to get on, don't! Crazy girl...

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Well then, shall I tell you now which objects you have on you that are stolen?

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: If you have any quibbles, we can bring people to corroborate what I've said, and all will come to light.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: If I lose, I'll pay you twenty thousand Mora. But if I win, then you'll be eating prison rations in Liyue Harbor tonight.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: How about it? If you're real legitimate businessmen, there's nothing to fear, is there?

response.speaker: Tyler
response.text: You... You!

response.speaker: Tyler
response.text: You've pushed it too far, brat!

response.speaker: Tyler
response.text: I don't know how you found out, but as long as we get rid of you, no one will have to know!

choices.text: Do I need to pay?

response.speaker: Tyler
response.text: No need, no need, we're already heading that way anyway.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How about this Crab Roe Tofu...

dialogues.speaker: Yuhua
dialogues.text: Though tofu could not be a more ordinary ingredient, it and crab roe are truly a match made in heaven. It's one of our specialties.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Th—This aroma is...

choices.text: Something to go with your noodles.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: I never thought it'd be so luxurious...

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Fine. Since my disciple has put in so much time and effort, I must — with great difficulty — accept.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: ...Aah! It's delicious! It's the most delicious thing I've eaten recently!

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Ah, uh, I mean... *cough* I never knew that my disciple was this skilled. As your master, I am most comforted.

choices.text: As long as you're eating a full meal.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: I see that it's no boast to call them Liyue's delicacies.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: I suppose it wasn't too much to spend all this Mora on...

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Ah, it's nothing. Nothing at all. Now that we've eaten and drank our fill, we should be off.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: If we travel north from here, we should reach the <color=#00E1FFFF>Stone Gate</color>, and from there, we will be within the boundaries of Mondstadt.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: What deep mysteries shall we acquire knowledge of? *chuckles* I'm looking forward to it.

choices.text: You say that, but you're clearly relishing the meal.
Your special order, ma'am.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: W-Wow, it's incredible...!

dialogues.speaker: Mona

choices.text: Something to go with your noodles.

talks.objective: Give the Golden Crab (Normal or Delicious) to Mona
Continue your journey, head for the Stone Gate

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Zhu
dialogues.text: Thank you all so much. You're welcome to drop by again.

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Zhu
dialogues.text: Well, if this inn hasn't closed its doors yet, haha...

talks.objective: Talk to Mona as she rests

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: These Golden Shrimp Balls...

dialogues.speaker: Yuhua
dialogues.text: These are made using large, succulent shrimp wrapped in crispy-fried potatoes. They have an amazing texture.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Hmph, what did you think? Did that satisfy your expectations?

choices.text: Your combat abilities were amazing.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Such things are elementary for an astrologist.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Lies are worthless before astrology. Destiny and truth are written in the stars.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Though it may take more time to garner the specifics, I can read the gist of a situation at a glance.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But you did hit some bumps in the road...

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: That's because Teyvat's stars can only display the fates and truths of "this world."

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Anything related to you becomes like a fog that even I cannot penetrate.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: That is why I must meet that successor. With our knowledge combined, I might be able to gain new insight into your fate.

choices.text: I'm a little excited.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Ha. Whatever the case, you've got everything to gain from this trip.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Alright, I'm rested. Let's get this journey to <color=#00E1FFFF>Mondstadt</color> over with!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: *sigh* If only we had a cart...

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: I thought you weren't tired!

choices.text: I'm not getting my hopes up...
It's impressive that you saw through those bandits.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: There's no need to spend all that effort on me, I'm not in dire need of food...

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: I am a little hungry... but it's not a big deal.

dialogues.speaker: Yuhua
dialogues.text: Excuse me, what would you like to order?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: As for the Vegetarian Abalone...

dialogues.speaker: Yuhua
dialogues.text: It's exactly what it says on the label — abalone made from vegetarian ingredients. It's just as good as the real thing!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And this Bamboo Shoot Soup...

dialogues.speaker: Yuhua
dialogues.text: This is a favorite among our regulars. Bamboo shoots, meat and ham are cooked together, creating a richly-flavored soup.

dialogues.speaker: Yuhua
dialogues.text: Pour a few spoonfuls into each bowl of rice you eat — you'll never get enough of it!
